facts.fact: Each of the8 listed fields has ordinary attr_accessor and is initialized to integer0. No class-side clamp/type/total consistency or automatic battle classification is attached to those generated accessors. won/lost result classification and timing belong to CORE finite source facts, not these comments/defaults.

pbSet returns before work for nil/false ID or ID<0. Otherwise writes variables[id]=value if game_variables exists, then marks game_map.need_refresh=true if game_map exists. Setter writes @data[id] only if id<=5000, without lower-bound/type/value validation; pbSet supplies lower-bound guard. Even id>5000 can still mark map refresh. Missing variable receiver does not prevent refresh. Setter failure prevents later refresh; a successful write is not undone by later map failure. Getter returns stored nonnil value for id<=5000, else0. No event command/UI refresh or save forced.

player registration class-validates Player, saves same $player object, load closure directly assigns it, newgame constructs Player(Unnamed,first TrainerType). stats registration boot-loads, class-validates GameStats, saves same $stats object, loads by assignment, newgame constructs GameStats and reset_on_new_game. Top-level ensure_class checks is_a? only, not recursive fields/aliases/party/individual stat type.

Value.save calls its closure, validates resulting whole object class, returns it. compile_save_hash iterates registrations in order and assigns by ID; repeated IDs later replace earlier hash slot while all earlier callbacks already ran. If any callback/validation raises, no completed save hash is returned and save_to_file has not yet opened output, but callback side effects are retained. Value.load validates, calls assignment closure, and only then sets its loaded flag.

save_to_file first validates String and compiles hash, then opens destination wb and Marshal.dumps hash directly. No temp/rename/backup or rollback. Later write/Marshal failure can leave truncated/partial file. get_data_from_file opens path, Marshal.loads first object; if Hash returns that hash without reading trailing objects; otherwise treats as legacy object array and loads until EOF. Native serialization graphs/alias equality/security/runtime compatibility not executed or approved.

Per registration order, an included save hash key invokes Value.load even when value nil (class failure possible); missing key uses its newgame proc if defined. load_all_values skips already loaded registrations. Boot load selects notloaded&&boot flag, so stats may already be active when ordinary Game.load later skips it. Reset/unloaded/newgame gates are per Value flags. Failure leaves prior loaded assignments/flags intact; no whole-graph rollback.

After input validation, writes safesave, increments game_system.save_count, writes magic_number, then stats.set_time_last_saved (which calls mutating play_time). These happen BEFORE begin rescue. In begin save_to_file then Graphics.frame_reset. Only IOError/SystemCallError rescue decrements save_count and returnsfalse; it does not restore safesave/magic/time/stat or file. Other errors including InvalidValueError propagate and do not decrement count. Frame-reset IO error can returnfalse after file successfully written. No failure meanstrue; not a disk atomicity or business success proof.

Game.load validates Hash→load_all_values→sets last_uptime reference→stats.play_sessions+=1→load_map→autoplay→game_map.update→PokemonMap.updateMap→Scene_Map.new assignment. Failures keep prior values/session increment. load_map sets game_map from map factory, checks magic/safesave, can rebuild/warp only DEBUG on missing map, rejects nil events, rebuilds encounters/vehicle. It does not rollback loaded stats/player. This supplies source static save/reload wiring, not all map/event business acceptance.

play_time getter conditionally reads System.uptime, adds delta to @play_time, then updates Game_Temp reference; no reference means returns existing time. set_time_last_saved stores that getter result. Getters are not all pure; old/malformed missing scalar fields are not filled by ensure_class. No host clock observed by target business.

common_premise: Default fixedR, no plugin override/concurrent mutation, legal standard objects and normally returning dependencies up to any stated failure; SOURCE_STATIC only. Exact full-source credit is original named reader, not receiver credit or a second vote.
open: No recursive field validity or alias/value equality after real serialize/reload accepted
No wholemap/wholeevent/wholeCORE or allStats business coverage
Conversions and externally supplied legacy input graphs beyond these explicitly stated read/load units are separate
